plot: On Road Painting Day at sunset Grumpy's three orange cones vanish one by one; Bolt tests Turbo (turns red) and Pip (tickled), then a cone wobbling on Bertha's roof gives her away: she used the cones to guard a baby-bird nest on her bus route; lesson: kind plans are better when shared; Grumpy brings new cones, then a nameless box appears on the podium.

script.title: The Cones Are Disappearing! 🚧😲 Wheelburg Mystery
script.description: It's Road Painting Day in Wheelburg, and Grumpy's orange cones vanish one by one while the paint is still wet! Inspector Bolt tests Turbo and Pip on the Truth Press, until something orange wobbles on a big yellow roof. Kind plans are better when you share them. Inspector Bolt #5

set.place: Wheelburg square, Road Painting Day sunset

beats.say: Vroom! Swish! Brushes up! It's Road Painting Day, and everybody raced into the square at sunset!
I'll paint the fastest stripes in history. Watch the master at work!
And I'll paint tiny stripes, for tiny cars like me!
I'm in charge of the orange cones. Cones keep the painters safe.
Good job, Grumpy! Three cones, all in a neat little row!
Three bright orange cones stood guard in front of the wet white paint.
Nobody touches my cones. They are the only orange things I like.
The sky turned pink and gold. Everybody started painting, swish, swish, swish.
One of my cones! It was right there a second ago!
Maybe it went for a little walk. Oh wait. Cones don't have wheels.
Without cones, somebody might drive right through the wet paint!
Beep beep! Inspector Bolt came rolling in with the evening breeze.
Good evening, everyone. I am told the cones are running away.
Two cones gone, Inspector. Only one left. Please find them.
Don't worry, Grumpy. Missing things always leave something behind.
First, procedure. Turbo, you are the fastest car here. Into the Truth Press, please.
Fast, yes. Cone thief, no! Cones are slow. I don't even like slow things.
Turbo, did you take Grumpy's cones?
No way! Squeeze me if you want. My eyes will stay super tiny.
The press squeezed. Turbo's eyes stayed small, but his face went very red.
Well... I was already red. So that doesn't count.
Honest. Thank you, Turbo. Back to your stripes.
But while everyone was watching the press, something else happened.
All three! My whole job, gone. This is the worst Painting Day ever.
Hmm. The thief strikes when we look away. Clever. But not clever enough.
Pip, you go next. Into the press, little one.
Okay! I'm brave! I'm brave! Is it going to tickle?
Pip, did you take the cones?
No! Cones are taller than me! I couldn't even carry one!
The press gave Pip the softest squeeze in all of Wheelburg.
Hee hee! It did tickle! Eyes small, see?
Small eyes. A cone is far too heavy for Pip. Honest.
Now Inspector Bolt looked at the whole square, from high above.
Three tall cones, taken very quickly. The thief must be big and strong.
Big and strong... Grumpy is big and strong!
No, Turbo. Grumpy is the one who lost them.
Then Big Bertha drove past, very slowly. And something orange wobbled on her roof.
Bertha! There's a cone on your roof! Like a big orange party hat!
A cone? On my roof? Goodness, how did that get up there?
Bertha, your eyes just grew very big. And you didn't even need the press.
Oh, buses are so bad at secrets. Okay. It was me. I took the cones.
Bertha? But you're my friend. Why did you take my cones?
On my bus route, by the bakery, there's a little bird nest right on the road.
Three baby birds are sleeping in it. Cars kept almost driving over them!
Baby birds? In the middle of the road? Oh no!
So I put your cones around the nest. Now every car drives around them.
I wanted to hurry back before anyone noticed. But this one got stuck on my roof.
So the cone thief was really... a cone hero?
Bertha. If you had told me, I would have helped. I know everything about cones.
You would? I thought you'd be grumpy about it.
I'm always grumpy. But never about baby birds.
Here is what I learned today. Kind plans are even better when you share them.
Tell your friends, and they can help you. Then nobody has to worry.
Next time I'll tell you first, Grumpy. I promise. And I'm sorry I worried you.
Sorry accepted. Now. Let's do this properly.
So Grumpy hurried off to the cone shop and brought back three brand new cones.
One, two, three! Bright new cones, right back where they belong.
And the baby birds keep their cones too! Everybody wins!
And I'll drive extra slowly past the bakery. Shhh. Baby birds sleeping.
Bertha. You can keep the cone on your roof. It suits you.
Really? My very own orange hat! Thank you, Grumpy!
Puzzle solved. Share your kind plans, Wheelburg. Help grows bigger when you share it.
The sun went down. But then...
A box on the podium? With no name on it? Hmm. Most curious.
What could be inside the mystery box? Inspector Bolt will find out, very soon!
